attempts.summary: Configured a nightly backup on node1 (cron, 02:30 daily) that SSHes into node2, tars /srv/inventory/data, and stores a dated gzip archive at /var/backups/inventory/inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz, pruning archives older than 7 days. Verified data flow, archive integrity, and retention pruning boundary. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
